soal:
[Pilihan Ganda Kompleks — Pilih Lebih dari Satu!]
Which statements are TRUE according to the specification table? (Choose TWO correct answers)

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Nova Tote is the cheapest bag, but it holds the fewest books (5 books).

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Aero Bag can hold more books than Nova Tote, and it is cheaper than Terra Pack.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Terra Pack is lighter than Aero Bag.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Nova Tote is better than Terra Pack for hiking in heavy rain.

opsi.label: A
opsi.teks: Nova Tote is the cheapest bag, but it holds the fewest books (5 books).

opsi.label: B
opsi.teks: Aero Bag can hold more books than Nova Tote, and it is cheaper than Terra Pack.

opsi.label: C
opsi.teks: Terra Pack is lighter than Aero Bag.

opsi.label: D
opsi.teks: Nova Tote is better than Terra Pack for hiking in heavy rain.

pembahasan: Pernyataan A benar (Nova Tote termurah Rp150.000 dengan muatan paling sedikit 5 buku). Pernyataan B benar (Aero Bag muat 8 buku > Nova Tote 5 buku, dan Rp185.000 lebih murah dari Terra Pack Rp240.000).

soal:
[Pilihan Ganda Kompleks — Plural Nouns]
Which sentences use plural nouns and quantifiers correctly? (Choose TWO correct answers)

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Many children bring their own lunchboxes to school.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: We saw five deer and several sheep at the conservation park.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: My mother bought two sharp knifes and three loafs of bread.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: The teacher gave us many useful informations about the exam.

opsi.label: A
opsi.teks: Many children bring their own lunchboxes to school.

opsi.label: B
opsi.teks: We saw five deer and several sheep at the conservation park.

opsi.label: C
opsi.teks: My mother bought two sharp knifes and three loafs of bread.

opsi.label: D
opsi.teks: The teacher gave us many useful informations about the exam.

pembahasan: A benar ('children' dan 'lunchboxes' jamak beraturan/tidak beraturan yang benar). B benar ('deer' dan 'sheep' bentuk jamak tanpa akhiran -s). Pilihan C salah ('knives' dan 'loaves'). Pilihan D salah ('information' uncountable noun, tidak boleh 'informations').

teks_soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements comparing the three bags and give a tick in the True or False column!
soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements comparing the three bags and give a tick in the True or False column!

pernyataan.teks: Terra Pack costs Rp55.000 more than Aero Bag.
Aero Bag can hold more thick books (8 books) than Terra Pack (12 books).
If a student needs to carry 10 thick books and rides a bicycle in the rain, Terra Pack is the most suitable choice.

pembahasan: (a) Benar: Rp240.000 - Rp185.000 = Rp55.000. (b) Salah: Terra Pack muat 12 buku, lebih banyak dari Aero Bag (8 buku). (c) Benar: Terra Pack muat 12 buku (memenuhi kebutuhan 10 buku) dan 100% waterproof cocok untuk hujan.
